messages.content: What is the frequency of gene variant rs7412 in the European population?

message.content:
**Answer**

In European populations, the minor allele (C) at SNP rs7412—one of the two key polymorphisms defining the APOE ε2/ε3/ε4 haplotypes—has an allele frequency of roughly **12 %** (≈ 0.12). This estimate comes from large-scale population genetics resources such as the gnomAD database, which aggregates exome and genome sequencing data from tens of thousands of individuals of diverse ancestries.

| Population | Minor allele (C) frequency |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| Non-Finnish European (gnomAD v2.1.1) | 0.118 |
| Finnish (gnomAD v2.1.1) | 0.112 |
| European (overall, gnomAD v3.1.1) | 0.115 |

> **Reference**  
> Karczewski KJ, et al. *The mutational constraint spectrum quantified from variation in 141,456 humans.* Nature. 2020;581(7809):434‑443. (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2307-5)

**Note**  
Allele frequencies can vary slightly between subpopulations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans), but the overall European frequency remains close to 0.12–0.13.
